name: Full-Stack Web Development
description: Web applications built across the interface, server logic, data layer, and deployment.
deliverable: A responsive product with connected application logic and persistence.
usefulFor: Product sites, internal tools, and complete web applications.

name: AI Chatbot Development
description: Conversational interfaces connected to AI models and supporting document or voice workflows where required.
deliverable: A task-focused assistant with a clear input and response flow.

name: AI Agents & Automation
description: Local or application-based agents that handle defined, repeatable information tasks.
deliverable: A documented workflow that collects, processes, and organizes information.
usefulFor: Listing checks and daily property updates.

name: API Development
description: REST endpoints and authentication flows for application features and integrations.
deliverable: Structured endpoints that connect interface, data, and services.
usefulFor: Application backends, service integrations, and data workflows.

name: Database Design & Integration
description: Data models and persistence layers aligned with an application’s records and relationships.
deliverable: An application data layer connected to the product workflows.
usefulFor: Document sharing, user accounts, and structured application records.
